title: VS-27 — Business Hub & Atlas Brand Experience

notes: VS-27 adds read models and presentation over existing persisted Business/Profile/Media/Offering/Context records; it does not add provider ingestion or a new persistence model.
The existing five-tab PES mobile structure and route names remain unchanged.
The current editable Business Profile flow remains available behind an explicit secondary edit route.
Third-party image binaries are never copied or rehosted; only existing bounded HTTPS references are rendered.
The remote Starbucks prototype brand asset is removed and replaced with an Atlas-owned local Compass Orbit mark; no Starbucks artwork or trade dress is copied.
No Today Focus readiness logic or VS-26 goal-first onboarding behavior is changed.
No production release, production enablement, EAS build/submit/OTA or deployment is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved the recommended read-first Business Hub direction, compact menu intelligence with a dedicated full-menu view, and Atlas-owned brand experience.
VS-27 presents already-governed persisted records and introduces no new provider collection, retention class, sensitive-data category or production policy boundary.
Product Owner approved the VS-27 design and Superpowers implementation plan and instructed execution to proceed once VS-26 cleared PES.
